verses.1: Therefore, I consider us to be servants of Christ and custodians of the mysteries of God.
verses.2: The rest of the information is also required in the documents, so that a reliable person can be found.
verses.3: It’s too much for me to be questioned by you or by any human being. But I won’t question myself either.
verses.4: For nothing is a problem to me; I’m not concerned about it at all. It’s the Lord who will judge me.
verses.5: So that you may not judge in haste, until the Lord comes. He will also illuminate the hidden things of darkness and make the intentions of people’s hearts known. Then, praise will be given to each person by God.
verses.6: These, brothers, I have taken upon myself and entrusted them to Apollonius, so that you may learn from them what is written: “Do not be influenced by what is written, so that none of you should be dominated by the nature of another.”
verses.7: What does it distinguish you from others? What do you have that you haven’t received? And even if you have received it, why should you be proud of not having received it?
verses.8: You have already been crowned kings; you have already become rich. You ruled over us, but in reality, you only ruled for your own benefit, so that we could also rule along with you.
verses.9: I believe that the God revealed us as messengers of death, so that we could become a spectacle to the world, both to people and to angels.
verses.10: We are weak through Christ, but you are strong in Christ. We are feeble, but you are powerful. You are glorious, but we are humble.
verses.11: Until the time of evening, we will suffer, endure hardships, exercise ourselves, and be strong.
verses.12: And we shall work with our own hands; we shall pray fervently, and we shall endure all hardships.
verses.13: We beg for forgiveness. Since we have become objects of contempt in this world, it is better to be ignored than to be treated with disrespect.
verses.14: I do not write these things to annoy you, but rather to teach my beloved children.
verses.15: For if you have children in Christ, but not many fathers, then in Christ Jesus, through the gospel, I have given birth to you.
verses.16: Therefore, I ask you, my followers, to become like me.
verses.17: Therefore, I have sent you Timotheus, my beloved and faithful son. He will remember my teachings about Christ Jesus for you, as I always teach in every church.
verses.18: Some people have become accustomed to not coming to you.
verses.19: I will come to you quickly, if the Lord so desires. I will then understand not only the words of those who are prophesied, but also their power.
verses.20: For the kingdom of God does not lie in words alone, but also in power.
verses.21: What do you want? Shall I come to you in the form of a rod, or in the form of love and grace?
